Messages.Body:
In our recent Draft tournament 2 questions regarding Malkavian Prank popped
up.

1. Does the Meth playing the Prank have to guess each players
counter-in-hand number and then all reveal at the same time or can he do it
one by one ?

2. Can a player with 1 pool take more than 1 pool in his hand ? What happens
if the player Malkavian Prank guesses the right amount e.g 3 does he get the
1 pool from the player and 2 from the blood bank or does he just get 1 ?
